title.en: 1.1 What a substation is—and what it need not contain

h.en: What a substation is—and what it need not contain

body.en:
Definition

An electrical substation is an organised power-system installation where circuits are connected, switched, protected, measured or controlled, and where voltage transformation may also be performed.

Detailed explanation and application

  • A transformer is not essential to every substation: a switching substation can interconnect circuits at the same voltage. Asubstation is therefore not simply “a place that reduces voltage”.
  • Substations connect generation, transmission and distribution while dividing the network into controllable protected zones. They enable fault isolation, maintenance and planned expansion.
  • In India, voltage transformation and reliable switching support diverse demand centres, renewable connections and interstate/state networks; actual utility design and grid requirements determine each station’s duty.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electrical substation power-systemનું organised installation છે જ્યાં circuits connect, switch, protect, measure/control થાય અને જરૂર હોય તો voltage transformation પણ થાય છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • દરેક substationમાં transformer જરૂરી નથી; switching substation સમાન voltageનાં circuits જોડે છે.એટલે substation માત્ર voltage ઘટાડવાનું સ્થળ નથી.
  • Substations generation, transmission/distribution જોડે અને networkને controllable protected zonesમાં વહેંચે; fault isolation, maintenance/expansion શક્ય બનાવે.
  • ભારતમાં voltage transformation/reliable switching demand centres, renewables/interstate-state networksને મદદ કરે; actual utility/grid requirements station duty નક્કી કરે.

title.en: 1.2 Classification by function: transmission, distribution, switching

h.en: Classification by function: transmission, distribution, switching

body.en:
Definition

Functional classification names a substation by the principal network task it performs, rather than only by its physical size or whether it contains a transformer.

Classification / scope

  • Transmission, distribution and switching are source-listed functions; converter, traction and industrial stations are additional application categories, not substitutes for the basic classification.

Detailed explanation and application

  • A transmission substation transfers bulk power between high-voltage circuits and may interconnect voltage levels. Adistribution substation feeds lower-voltage distribution circuits and loads.
  • A switching station sectionalises/interconnects circuits without necessarily changing voltage. Step-up/step-down describe transformation direction at a particular power-flow condition.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Functional classification substationના મુખ્ય network કાર્ય પ્રમાણે થાય છે, માત્ર size/transformerની હાજરીથી નહીં.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Transmission, distribution/switching source-listed functions છે; converter, traction/industrial વધારાની application categories છે, basic classificationના વિકલ્પ નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Transmission substation bulk power transfer/voltage-level interconnection કરે; distribution substation lower-voltage circuits/loadsને supply આપે.
  • Switching station voltage બદલ્યા વિના circuits sectionalise/interconnect કરી શકે.Step-up/step-down particular power-flow conditionમાં transformation direction બતાવે.

h.en: Voltage classes and nominal versus highest voltage
h.gu: Voltage Classes તથા Nominal/Highest Voltageનો ભેદ

body.en:
Definition

Nominal system voltage identifies the network operating-voltage class, while highest voltage for equipment specifies the upper system-voltage basis used for its insulation/rating coordination.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Common Indian transmission examples include 66, 132, 220, 400and 765 kV; 11/22/33kVare common distribution-network levels. Boundaries of LV/MV/HV/EHVdepend on the stated standard or utility convention.
  • Do not mix older statutory voltage definitions, engineering usage and an equipment catalogue as one universal table. State the convention before classifying a voltage.
  • For example, 66kVnominal is commonly associated with 72.5kVhighest equipment class; 132with 145, and 220with 245.This does not mean the bus normally operates at its highest equipment rating.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Nominal system voltage networkની operating-voltage class ઓળખાવે છે; highest voltage for equipment insulation/rating coordination માટેનું upper system-voltage basis છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • ભારતમાં66, 132, 220, 400/765 kV transmission તથા11/22/33 kV distributionનાં common examples છે.LV/MV/HV/EHV boundaries stated standard/utility પ્રમાણે બદલાય.
  • જૂની statutory definitions, engineering usage/catalogueને એક universal table નમાનો.Classify કરતાં પહેલાં convention લખો.
  • ઉદાહરણ: 66 kV nominal માટે72.5 kV highest class, 132 માટે145/220 માટે245 સામાન્ય છે.Bus હંમેશાં highest rating પર operate થતો નથી.

h.en: Indoor, outdoor, AIS, GIS and hybrid arrangements
h.gu: Indoor, Outdoor, AIS, GIS તથા Hybrid

body.en:
Definition

An indoor/outdoor classification identifies the installation environment, whereas AIS/GIS identifies the primary insulation arrangement; these are independent classification axes.

Classification / scope

  • Indoor/outdoor: environment; AIS/GIS/HGIS: insulation/construction; function/voltage: network duty.

Detailed explanation and application

  • AIS uses air for the main external insulation; GIS encloses major live parts in gas-insulated grounded metal compartments. Hybrid arrangements combine selected technologies.
  • GIS can be indoor or outdoor; an indoor station is not automatically GIS. Selection balances land, pollution, maintenance, access, fire risk, lifecycle cost and environmental obligations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Indoor/outdoor installation environment બતાવે; AIS/GIS primary insulation arrangement બતાવે; બંને independent classification axes છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Indoor/outdoor: environment; AIS/GIS/HGIS: insulation/construction; function/voltage: network duty.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • AISમાં મુખ્ય external insulation air છે; GISમાં live parts grounded metal gas compartmentsમાં બંધ હોય; hybridમાં selected technologies જોડાય.
  • GIS indoor/outdoor હોઈ શકે; indoor એટલે GIS નહીં.Selectionમાં land, pollution, maintenance, access, fire, lifecycle/environment જોવાય.

body.en:
Definition

Substation reliability is the ability to perform the required supply/switching function under specified conditions; maintainability is the ability to restore or retain that function through practical maintenance actions.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Redundancy can reduce outage exposure but adds equipment, protection and common-mode failure paths. N−1is a defined contingency criterion, not a claim of zero interruption for every fault.
  • Safe segregation, fire/drainage measures, earthing and access control protect people and assets; maintainable layouts allow equipment removal without exposing workers to adjacent live parts.
  • Scalability needs future bays, space, conductor/bus rating, short-circuit capability, DCcapacity and communication expansion—not only an empty plot.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Substation reliability specified conditionsમાં required supply/switching કાર્ય કરવાની ક્ષમતા છે; maintainability practical maintenanceથી તે કાર્ય જાળવવા/restore કરવાની ક્ષમતા છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Redundancy outage exposure ઘટાડે પણ equipment/protection/common-mode failures ઉમેરે.N−1 defined contingency criterion છે, દરેક faultમાં zero interruptionનો દાવો નહીં.
  • Segregation, fire/drainage, earthing/access control people/assets બચાવે; maintainable layoutમાં adjacent live partsના exposure વિના equipment removal શક્ય હોય.
  • Scalabilityમાં future bays, space, bus/current/fault rating, DC capacity/communications જોઈએ; માત્ર ખાલી plot નહીં.

h.en: Site selection: from land to system study
h.gu: Site Selection: જમીનથી System Study સુધી

body.en:
Definition

Site selection is the coordinated assessment of electrical location, ground conditions, environmental/social constraints and safe constructability/operation for the proposed station duty.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Locate relative to load/network corridors while examining voltage drop, losses, reliability and future growth; the geographically closest site is not always the best electrical site.
  • Check flood level, stormwater drainage, bearing capacity, seismic needs, soil resistivity, contamination and groundwater; soil resistivity and structural strength are different properties.
  • Transformer transport route, crane access, fire access, control-room cable routes, fencing and safe maintenance zones affect lifetime usability.
  • Land approvals, clearances, noise/oil containment, community concerns and access security must be reviewed by the responsible authority; an educational site matrix is not planning permission.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Site selection proposed duty માટે electrical location, ground conditions, environment-social constraints તથા safe construction/operationનું coordinated assessment છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Load/network corridorsસાપેક્ષ voltage drop, losses, reliability/growth જુઓ; geographically નજીકનું site હંમેશાં electrically શ્રેષ્ઠ નથી.
  • Flood, drainage, bearing capacity, seismic, soil resistivity, contamination/groundwater તપાસો.Soil resistivity/structural strength જુદાં છે.
  • Transformer transport, crane/fire access, cable routes, fencing/maintenance zones lifetime usability નક્કી કરે.
  • Land approvals, clearances, noise/oil containment, community/security competent authority review કરે; educational matrix planning permission નથી.

title.en: 1.4 Physical layout and its auxiliary systems

h.en: Physical layout and its auxiliary systems

body.en:
Definition

A physical layout is a scaled arrangement of equipment, structures, buildings, cable routes and safe access areas; it is not the same document as an electrical single-line diagram.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Switchyard contains bays, bus structures and primary apparatus; control building contains protection/control, communication and operating facilities. Auxiliaries include ACsupply, DCbattery/chargers, fire protection, lighting, drainage and earthing.
  • Draw maintenance withdrawal routes, cable trench separation, oil collection/fire separation and future bays; dimensioned clearances must come from an approved design, not symbol spacing on a page.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Physical layout equipment, structures, buildings, cables/safe accessનું scaled arrangement છે; તે electrical SLD જેવો document નથી.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Switchyardમાં bays, bus/primary apparatus; control buildingમાં protection/control, communication/operation છે.Auxiliariesમાં AC, DC battery/chargers, fire, lighting, drainage/earthing આવે.
  • Withdrawal routes, cable separation, oil/fire separation/future bays દોરો.Dimensioned clearance approved designથી લો, page પર symbol gapથી નહીં.

h.en: SLD symbols and the protective bay

body.en:
Definition

A single-line diagram represents the principal three-phase electrical connections by one line per circuit, with standardised equipment symbols and device identification.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Aline bay can include surge arrester, CVT/VT, PLCCcoupling/line trap, disconnectors, earthing switches, CTand circuit breaker; actual order and arrangement are design-dependent.
  • CB interrupts its rated load/fault current; disconnector provides rated isolation but is not a generic fault interrupter. CT supplies scaled current; VT/CVT supplies scaled voltage to protection/metering.
  • CTsecondary must not be opened when primary current flows; VTsecondary must not be shorted casually. Show protection zones and DCtrip path because a symbol alone does not prove fault clearance.

Reliability and safety checks

  • An SLDdoes not establish absence of voltage or permission to operate. Obtain exact approved drawings/device tags and authority.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Single-line diagram મુખ્ય three-phase connectionsને પ્રતિ circuit એક line તથા standard symbols/device IDsથી બતાવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Line bayમાં arrester, CVT/VT, PLCC/line trap, disconnectors, earth switches, CT/CB હોઈ શકે; actual order design પ્રમાણે છે.
  • CB rated load/fault interrupt કરે; disconnector rated isolation આપે, generic fault interruption નહીં.CT scaled current/VT-CVT scaled voltage protection/meteringને આપે.
  • Primary currentમાં CT secondary open નહીં; VT secondary casual short નહીં.Protection zones/DC trip path બતાવો; symbolથી clearance સાબિત નથી થતું.

વિશ્વસનીયતા તથા સલામતીની ચકાસણી

  • SLD absence-of-voltage/operation permission નથી; exact approved drawings/tags/authority જોઈએ.

h.en: Single bus, sectionalised bus, double bus
h.gu: Single Bus, Sectionalised Bus તથા Double Bus

body.en:
Definition

A bus scheme is the arrangement by which circuits connect to common electrical nodes and switching devices to achieve a chosen balance of reliability, flexibility and cost.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Single bus is simple but a bus fault or bus maintenance can affect many circuits. Sectionalising can confine some outages and transfer load only if ratings/protection permit.
  • Double bus with one breaker per circuit permits bus selection through disconnectors and a coupler but is not equivalent to two independent breakers per circuit. Incorrect bus-selector operation can connect incompatible buses.
  • Illustrative 66kVsingle-bus, 132kVsectionalised and 220kVdouble-bus diagrams teach connectivity, not mandatory voltage-to-scheme rules. Actual station reliability study decides.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Bus scheme circuitsને common nodes/switching devices સાથે જોડવાની arrangement છે જે reliability, flexibility/costનું સંતુલન નક્કી કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Single bus સરળ, પણ bus fault/maintenanceમાં ઘણા circuits અસરગ્રસ્ત.Sectionalisingથી કેટલીક outage મર્યાદિત થાય; transfer ratings/protection પ્રમાણે જ.
  • Double bus/one CBમાં selectors/couplerથી bus choice મળે, બે independent CB સમાન નહીં.Wrong selector operation incompatible buses જોડે.
  • Illustrative 66 kV single, 132 kV sectionalised/220 kV double-bus connectivity શીખવે, mandatory voltage-rule નહીં.Actual reliability study નિર્ણય કરે.

h.en: Reading voltage, MVA and current on an SLD
h.gu: SLD પર Voltage, MVA તથા Current વાંચવું

body.en:
Definition

Apparent-power rating states the voltage–current loading capability under specified conditions; it must be distinguished from real power, fault current and energy delivered over time.

Detailed explanation and application

  • For balanced sinusoidal three-phase service, S=√3VLI L and P=S cosφ.The same ideal transformer MVAcan correspond to very different winding-side currents.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Use line-to-line RMSvoltage VL and line RMScurrent IL; three-phase total S=3VphIph=√3VLIL.
  2. Rearrange IL=S/(√3VL).Asteady MVAcalculation does not select breaker fault duty, bus short-time withstand or a cable installation derating.

Worked example / interpretation

  1. An illustrative 20 MVA 66/11kVtransformer carries about 174.95Aon 66kV and 1049.73Aon 11 kV at rated MVA; losses and taps modify exact service values.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Apparent-power rating specified conditionsમાં voltage-current loading capability બતાવે છે; real power, fault current/time-energyથી તેને અલગ રાખવું.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Balanced sinusoidal three-phaseમાં S=√3VLIL/P=S cosφ.Ideal transformerના સમાન MVAમાં બંને sidesના currents જુદા હોય.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Line-to-line RMS VL/line RMS IL લો; total S=3VphIph=√3VLIL.
  2. IL=S/(√3VL).Steady MVAથી CB fault duty, bus short-time rating/cable derating નક્કી નથી થતાં.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / અર્થઘટન

  1. Illustrative 20 MVA 66/11kVમાં rated currents આશરે66 kV પર174.95 A/11 kV પર1049.73 A; losses/tapsથી exact values બદલાય.

body.en:
Definition

A higher-voltage station SLDshows the same functional equipment roles at a different network interface; ratings and reliability studies determine the actual arrangement.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Trace the 132kVincoming disconnector, breaker and CTthrough the bus and transformer to 33kVoutgoing breakers. Measurement/protection and DCtrip are separate secondary paths.
  • Voltage ratio is 132/33=4under nominal ideal conditions; this alone gives neither transformer MVAnor short-circuit interrupting rating.
  • For a sectionalised or double-bus version, add only the approved coupler/selector arrangement and review zone boundaries; do not improvise switching operations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Higher-voltage SLD જુદા network interface પર સમાન equipment roles બતાવે; actual arrangement ratings/reliability study નક્કી કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • 132kVincoming DS, CB/CTથી bus-transformer/33kVoutgoing CB trace કરો.Measurement/protection/DCtrip અલગ paths છે.
  • Nominal ideal voltage ratio 132/33=4; આથી transformer MVA/fault interrupting rating નથી મળતી.
  • Sectionalised/double-busમાં approved coupler/selectors/zone review જ; switching improvise નહીં.

h.gu: 220/66 kV SLD: Interface તથા Bus Choice

body.en:
Definition

An interconnecting station links network voltage levels through rated equipment and coordinated protection; its SLDrepresents the electrical connectivity, not the site’s physical clearance.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Trace 220kVsource, bay CB/CT, bus, transformer and 66kVoutgoing paths; the conceptual drawing simplifies shunt VT/LAbranches for clarity.
  • Nominal ratio 220/66≈3.333does not define load current without MVA. Double bus is a possible reliability arrangement, not a mandatory consequence of 220 kV.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interconnecting station rated equipment/coordinated protectionથી voltage levels જોડે; SLD connectivity બતાવે, physical clearance નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • 220kVsource, CB/CT, bus, transformer/66kVoutgoing trace કરો; clarity માટે shunt VT/LAbranches drawingમાં simplified છે.
  • 220/66≈3.333ratioથી MVAવિના current નમળે.Double bus possible છે, 220kVથી mandatory નહીં.
